name: Battlecards
description: Turn any table into a deck of cards - one card per row, ready as a multi-page PDF. Paste straight from your spreadsheet, doc, or chat.
a11yLabel: Battlecards: {{default title "Battlecards"}} - one card per table row

inputs.label: Table
inputs.help: One card per row. The first column is each card's title; the other column headings become its field labels. Cells take markdown - **bold**, *italic*, # headings, - bullet and 1. numbered lists, [links](url) and ![images](url). Paste a table copied from a spreadsheet, Notion, Slack, or Markdown - or click any text on the card to edit it in place (it bakes back to markdown here). An optional Icon column puts a small image on each card: click the top-right corner of a card to pick one from the catalog. The Copy button hands the finished table back to your spreadsheet.

inputs.label: Orientation
inputs.help: The card layout adapts: fields flow as a grid in landscape and stack in portrait.
